set.body: Current DL heterogeneity plus normal-reference testing is algebraically consistent with metafor(method=DL,test=z), but under independent normal null data with known first-level variances from 0.04 to 1.0 and between-participant variance tau2=0.2, 20,000 simulations reject at nominal alpha=.05 in 11.60% of n=8, 7.90% of n=20, and 5.58% of n=80 cases. No invalid fits. These are pointwise calibration results, not spatial FWER tests. Owner: ScalaFIM group inference; estimator expansion tracked at bd-01KX2CQZGWBQ3KKX7BWE28X3T2. Acceptance: explicit estimator/reference-distribution contracts, independent small-sample calibration including estimated first-level SEs/df, covariates/heterogeneity/imbalance; compare justified REML/PM and small-sample-adjusted or resampled inference candidates; define admission boundaries; do not relabel current z p-values as calibrated defaults. Evidence: group audit bd-01M20MJY5QG8F7X2ZQENTTWPD7 and GroupCalibration.
set.title: Qualify finite-sample group meta-regression inference before default admission
